reviews.text:
Elmo the Havanese went to Bonjour for grooming. The experience was new for our 13 year old dog and everything went even better than we expected. Groomer Iwona did a great job and we got home a very clean and happy dog.

Elmo and the owners thank you!
The gentleman came out really clean and was trimmed according to his wishes! The job was done beautifully even though it was only the gentleman's second trim in his entire life. ❤️
Helene is a great groomer, who can tackle difficult fur ( and behavior).
Hi Tuulikki, thanks for stopping by! 🤩 Have a nice week and a very happy Midsummer! ✨💛 …

Riki is always happy to go for a bath and to be cuddled here.
Thank you!!! See you again!

The best place if you want your doggy looking fabulous! Our Shiba Inu pup loves going here for his manicures and occasional wash and blow-outs, as the ladies are so professional, attentive and give him lots of affection and kisses. And Mochi, being a drama queen he usually is, doesn't even have time to warm up and kick-start his usual Shiba screaming, as all the nail trimming happens so lightning fast. Fully recommend!
well done grooming, dog was happy. Good service!
Thank you!! 🤩🤩 See you again and have a nice weekend! 💛🐶 …
Super friendly and professional service every time! I've been a regular customer with my dog for more than a year now.

Maggie 7 years old can already give a full 5 stars for grooming and service with several years of experience! She comes in with a wiggly tail and comes out just as happy. A truly professional team 🐾 Now for the summer Maggie wanted a slightly shorter summer trim 🕶️ …
Thank you! 🤩 Have a nice weekend and see you again 😊💛 …
Moët got a “down-sizing” and is now a skinny and cute little dog with a slightly different personality! Thank you👏🏻❤️🐶 …
Thank you!! 🤩🤩 See you again and have a nice day 💛🐕 …

Really good grooming salon! Professionals on the job. My dog ​​and I were taken care of nicely. The result of the work was impeccable. Clean premises. Online appointment booking worked well. Highly recommended!
The dog loves it, Zara runs to get groomed, friendly and good service❤️
